children: Greece’s current account surplus narrowed to EUR 0.22 billion in July 2026, from EUR 0.67 billion in the same month last year.

The goods deficit rose to EUR 3.15 billion from EUR 2.92 billion a year earlier, as imports (EUR 8.12 billion) grew more than exports (EUR 4.97 billion) in absolute terms. At the same time, the primary income gap widened to EUR 0.68 billion from EUR 0.57 billion, reflecting higher net interest, dividend, and profit payments.
The secondary income deficit also increased to EUR 0.60 billion from EUR 0.24 billion a year earlier, owing to higher net payments mainly in the general government sector.
Meanwhile, the services surplus edged up to EUR 4.65 billion from EUR 4.39 billion, mainly attributed to an increase in the travel balance.

title: Greece Current Account Surplus Narrows in July
